current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application process step 2' page still links this non-householder checklist and the companion Householder checklist (both 'Version February 2025'), and a search found no newer list.

issues.detail: Several Part 2 local requirements in the Feb 2025 non-householder list are not captured under any application type: Agricultural Statement (new agricultural or equestrian buildings in the countryside, and new dwellings justified by agricultural need); Air Source Heat Pump Calculation (MCS calculation for a single ASHP in a defined settlement, BS 4142 noise assessment for multiple installations without MCS 020); Climate Mitigation Statement (all development creating new floorspace or changing the use of existing floorspace); Flood Risk Management Statement and Flood Impact Form (non-major development in Causal Areas, Policy NBE5); Shop Front Details (all new shop fronts); Telecommunications Report (all new telecoms antennas).
issues.evidence: Part 2 Local Requirements: 'Climate Mitigation Statement - For all development proposing new floorspace and changes of use of existing floorspace'; 'Shop Front Details - All applications for new shop fronts'; 'Telecommunications Report - For all new telecommunications antenna'

issues.detail: Householder: the Air Source Heat Pump Calculation is not captured as a requirement with its trigger. Grokbot has a 'Noise Impact Assessment' row whose only text is 'BS 4142:2014-compliant Noise Impact Assessment.', which is a fragment of the ASHP item. The trigger (new single or multiple ASHPs within a defined settlement) is missing.
issues.evidence: Householder list Part 2: 'All new single air-source heat pumps within a defined settlement' need an MCS Calculation; 'All new multiple airsource heat pump installations, situated within a defined settlement' need a BS 4142:2014 Noise Impact Assessment

issues.detail: Several triggers are copied from the neighbouring item in a two-column PDF layout. Full planning 'Lighting Assessment' uses the Landscaping trigger (majors, Conservation Area). The source trigger is floodlit sports or recreation, any major, residential or commercial development with external lighting, and countryside sites of ecological interest. Full planning 'Noise Impact Assessment' uses the ASHP fragment. The source triggers are dwellings or schools within 300m of the M3, within 100m of a railway or inside Farnborough Airport's 50dB LAeq contour, plus motor sports, shooting, nurseries and windfarms. Householder 'Flood Risk Assessment' uses the Design and Access Statement trigger ('100m2 or more of additional floorspace in a Conservation Area'). Householder 'Contaminated Land' and 'Ecological Survey' share the same garbled two-column text, so the ecology trigger is missing. That trigger is demolition, tree or hedge loss, within 0.5km of waterways or ponds, or within 2km of an SSSI or ancient woodland.
issues.evidence: Lighting Assessment: 'Any major or residential or commercial development where external lighting is proposed'; Noise: 'New dwellings and schools that are proposed close to major roads (within 300m of the M3)'

issues.detail: Some triggers are cut off or are content text rather than the trigger. Full planning Ecological Assessment stops at 'SSSI... or SINC; or' and drops major development, one or more new homes, and 100m2 or more of new floorspace. 'Parking provision' is only '21 Item Parking Statement Plan When required'. 'Cycle parking' is the fragment 'Also where cycle stores are required;'. Contaminated Land quotes content text and omits the triggers: likely contamination from existing or previous uses, within 250m of a former landfill (excluding householder), or contamination known to exist. Town Centre Uses omits the over-2,500m2 out-of-centre threshold. 'Waste / Refuse' and 'SANGS' share one merged excerpt, so 'New retail or commercial premises' (a Refuse trigger) appears inside the SANGS trigger.
issues.evidence: Ecological Assessment: 'Any major development; Creation of one or more new homes; ...floor space created by the development is 100 square metres or more'

issues.detail: The Full planning rows for Affordable Housing Statement, Crime Prevention / ASB Statement and Employment / Economic Statement take their 'trigger' from the column headers of the 2022 'Validation Requirements key' matrix, not from the list. The actual triggers are: Affordable Housing for 10+ dwellings gross or over 1,000m2 residential floorspace, regeneration of affordable housing, and rural exception schemes. Crime Prevention for 25+ dwellings, E/B2/B8 over 1,500m2, pubs, nightclubs, hotels, takeaways, restaurants, ATMs and banks. Economic Statement for rural commercial development, E/B2/B8 over 1,500m2, or loss of E/B2/B8 land.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'matters reserved) Affordable Housing Statement Agricultural Statement Causal Flood Area Proforma Crime Prevention/ ASB Statement Economic Statement Full Planning Permission (commercial)...'

issues.detail: Transport Assessment, Travel Plan and Economic Statement are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The list does not apply them to prior approvals, which have their own prescribed information. The text says 'change of use' in the content, but the items belong to full and outline non-householder applications. Tree Survey/AMS and 'Schedule of works (listed building)' are placed under 'Works to trees', but these are development-application requirements triggered by works near TPO trees, not tree works applications.
issues.evidence: Travel Plan: 'All planning applications for: a) Food and non-food retail...'; Tree Survey: 'An Arboricultural Method Statement must be provided where the development requires works to be carried out to a tree that is the subject of a Tree Preservation Order'

issues.detail: Most non-householder requirements (about 20 rows, e.g. BNG, Drainage, Flood Risk, Heritage, Planning Statement, SANGS/SAMM, Refuse, Town Centre Uses) are tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Outline, Reserved matters and Listed building consent are then given '(none)'. The non-householder list is a general list covering all non-householder applications. For example, Heritage Statement applies to listed building consent, and SANGS/SAMM, Affordable Housing and Transport Assessment apply to outline applications.
issues.evidence: Document title: 'General Validation Requirements (incorporating the local requirements)'; Outline row: 'No specific local requirements identified for this application type'

issues.detail: Some requirements are mapped to unrelated text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' (Householder and Works to trees) is mapped to the Arboricultural Method Statement / ancient woodland text, and neither list has a listed-building schedule-of-works item. Householder 'Block plan / Site plan' quotes Location Plan notes. Householder 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' quotes site plan content about window openings near the boundary, which is not a highways requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' -> 'An Arboricultural Method Statement must be provided where the development requires works to be carried out to a tree that is the subject of a Tree Preservation Order...'

issues.detail: Some rows are fragments rather than separate local requirements. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS)' ('and the Nationally Described Space Standards.') is drawing content advice. 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' ('including the loss of employment land.') is part of the Economic Statement content. 'Planning Obligations / S106 Heads of Terms' is advice within the Planning Statement item, not a standalone requirement. The 'Submission rules' tab item is boilerplate about the validation team's discretion.
issues.evidence: Hart non-householder list has no standalone NDSS, marketing evidence or Heads of Terms item; S106 text: 'In such a case it would be appropriate to provide draft heads of terms.'

issues.detail: Tab items are garbled by the two-column PDF extraction: page numbers and headings are mixed into the text, and items are merged. Examples: 'All drawings must be drawn to scale... 4 Relevant Policy or Guidance Ordnance Survey plans...'; 'Please clearly label Preferably 1:50 or 1:100 scale. relevant elevations and Show: annotate which floor the plans'; 'Final Report Item Refuse Bin storage details and collection points SANGS/SAMM Mitigation When required...'; '...units and bedrooms. 25 Relevant Policy or Guidance An SPA map...'. Only 10 tab items were captured from a list with 13 national and 25 local items.
issues.evidence: Tab item text as captured in workbook

issues.detail: Three Full planning rows (Affordable Housing, Crime Prevention, Economic Statement) cite the 2022-11 'Validation Requirements key' PDF. It is still linked from the step-2 page, but it predates the Feb 2025 lists, and Grokbot quoted its matrix headers rather than its contents.
issues.evidence: Step 2 page links 'validation requirements guide' at /sites/default/files/2022-11/Validation%20Requirements%20key-%20checked.pdf

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Feb 2025 non-householder list (with a Feb 2025 householder companion), and the date is correct. The extraction is poor: six local requirements are missing (Agricultural Statement, ASHP Calculation, Climate Mitigation Statement, Flood Risk Management Statement for Causal Areas, Shop Fronts, Telecoms). Many triggers are copied from adjacent items or cut off, and all non-householder items were put under Full planning only.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
